item.title: Gabriel Landeskog Back on the Shelf For Avalanche
item.description: Gabriel Landeskog just can't catch a break. item.title: Report: Brayden Schenn Almost Vetoed Islanders Trade
item.description: No-trade clauses became the big topic of discussion around and after the trade deadline this year. And for good reason. item.title: NHL Rumors: Devils to Move Simon Nemec for Top-Six Scorer
item.description: The New Jersey Devils could be one of the most aggressive teams this offseason, and Simon Nemec may be the centerpiece of a blockbuster move. According to reports from Pierre LeBrun of The Athletic and James Nichols of New Jersey Hockey Now, the Devils are open to moving the former No. 2 overall pick if it helps significantly upgrade their top-six forward group. item.title: Breaking Interview: Robert Thomas Reveals Exactly How Far Things Got at Deadline
